Benazir Income Support Payment Check: How to Confirm Yours

How to check your Benazir Income Support payment in 2026: the 8171 portal, the SMS method, the current stipend, collection tips and fraud warnings.

BISP logo — used for identification only · source

Short answer: To check your Benazir Income Support payment, use the official 8171 portal with your 13-digit CNIC, or send the CNIC by SMS to 8171. The widely cited current Benazir Kafaalat quarterly amount is Rs 13,500, with some 2026 reports of about Rs 14,500, so verify on the official portal because rules and dates change.

What Benazir Income Support pays

Benazir Income Support Programme is the federal social protection programme behind Benazir Kafaalat and related initiatives. Benazir Kafaalat is the core unconditional cash transfer for eligible families. Payments are made quarterly, and the programme has absorbed several earlier Ehsaas initiatives.

Current payment amount

The Benazir Kafaalat quarterly stipend was increased from Rs 10,500 to Rs 13,500 from January 2025, which is the widely cited current amount. Some 2026 reports mention a further increase to about Rs 14,500. Treat both as subject to change and confirm the figure that applies to you on the official portal.

  • Widely cited current amount: Rs 13,500 per quarter.
  • Reports in 2026 mention about Rs 14,500.
  • Your own amount may differ because of arrears or adjustments.

How to check your payment

  1. Open the official 8171 portal at 8171.bisp.gov.pk.
  2. Enter your own 13-digit CNIC without spaces.
  3. Read the eligibility and payment status.
  4. Alternatively, send your 13-digit CNIC by SMS to 8171.

You can also read general information at bisp.gov.pk. The portal is the only official source for your personal status.

Why payments arrive in phases

Each quarter is released in phases by district so that banks and campsites can cope. A neighbour may be paid before you even when both households are eligible. Wait for the official announcement of your phase before worrying about a pending result.

Collecting your payment

Collect from the designated bank or retailer, count the money before you leave, and keep the receipt. Some beneficiaries receive the money through a biometric system at a campsite. Follow the instructions on the official notice rather than advice from a crowd.

If the payment has not arrived

  • Recheck after the official phase announcement.
  • Confirm your CNIC details are correct and current.
  • Visit the nearest BISP tehsil office with your original CNIC.
  • Call the BISP helpline at 0800-26477.

Strong fraud warnings

Never pay an agent to get your Benazir Income Support money. Never share your OTP or PIN, and only ever use your own CNIC. Criminals may pose as officials, send fake payment messages, or offer to register you for a fee. None of that is legitimate.

Benazir Kafaalat and other BISP benefits

Benazir Kafaalat is the main cash transfer, but BISP also runs the Benazir Taleemi Wazaif education stipend and the Benazir Nashonuma nutrition programme. Each has its own conditions. A single CNIC check can show messages for the household, but the rules for each benefit are different.

  • Kafaalat: unconditional quarterly cash for eligible families.
  • Taleemi Wazaif: education stipend tied to enrolment and attendance.
  • Nashonuma: nutrition support for mothers and young children.

Using banks and retailers safely

Some beneficiaries collect at a bank counter, others at a designated retailer or campsite. At a retailer, confirm the amount aloud, count the cash, and insist on the receipt. If a retailer asks for a commission, refuse and report it through the helpline or the tehsil office. Your entitlement is not a favour.

Keeping your own records

Keep a small file with your CNIC copy, your 8171 screenshots, payment receipts and the dates you called or visited an office. If a payment is disputed, these records answer most questions quickly. Write down any reference number you are given.

Planning around a quarterly payment

Because payments are quarterly, plan your household budget for the months between instalments. Do not assume a fixed date; use the official announcement. If you rely on the payment for school fees or medicine, keep a buffer where you can.

Verify before you act

Amounts and dates change. Always confirm on 8171.bisp.gov.pk or bisp.gov.pk, or call 0800-26477. Wafa Smart Tech (wafasmart.tech) publishes free browser tools and web services, but only the official portal shows your true payment position.

Always confirm on the official site — this is general information, not a government service.

Frequently asked questions

How do I check my Benazir Income Support payment?
Use the official 8171 portal at 8171.bisp.gov.pk and enter your 13-digit CNIC, or send your CNIC by SMS to 8171.
How much does Benazir Kafaalat pay now?
The widely cited current amount is Rs 13,500 per quarter, increased from Rs 10,500 in January 2025. Some 2026 reports mention about Rs 14,500. Verify on the official portal.
Why is my payment late?
Payments are released in phases by district, so your area may not be reached yet. Check the official announcement and recheck the portal.
Can an agent get my payment faster?
No. There is no fee to receive BISP money. Never pay an agent, never share your OTP or PIN, and only use your own CNIC.
